restatement_groups.reason: Vehicles with a lower bumper height below 425 mm shall be tested with the lower legform.
Vehicles with a lower bumper height above 500 mm shall be tested with the upper legform.
For a lower bumper height between 425 and 500 mm, the manufacturer chooses the lower or upper legform test.
The legform-to-bumper impact speed is 40 km/h.

subject_absent.subject: Bonnet top and windscreen headform HIC

subject_absent.subject: Bonnet top headform HIC
subject_absent.text: When tested with the child and adult headforms in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3, 4 and 5, the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two-thirds of the bonnet top test area.

subject_absent.subject: Bonnet/windscreen remaining test areas headform HIC
subject_absent.text: When tested with the child and adult headforms in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3, 4 and 5, the HIC for the remaining test areas shall not exceed 1,700 for both headforms.

subject_absent.subject: Child headform test area HIC
subject_absent.text: In case there is only a child headform test area, the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the test area.

subject_absent.subject: Child headform remaining area HIC
subject_absent.text: In case there is only a child headform test area, the HIC for the remaining area shall not exceed 1,700.

subject_absent.subject: Child headform test area HIC (one half)
subject_absent.text: When tested with the child headform in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3 and 4, the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over a minimum of one half of the child headform test area.

subject_absent.subject: Child headform remaining areas HIC
subject_absent.text: When tested with the child headform in accordance with Annex 5, paragraphs 3 and 4, the HIC for the remaining areas shall not exceed 1,700.

subject_absent.subject: end-outline marker lamp
subject_absent.text: The colour of the light emitted by the end-outline marker lamp shall be white in front and red at the rear.

subject_absent.subject: manoeuvring lamp
subject_absent.text: The colour of the light emitted by the manoeuvring lamp shall be white.
